source: Daniel's Running Formula, Figure 1.5 — Jack Daniels, PhD
description: The principle of diminishing returns: as weekly mileage increases, the percentage of running potential achieved rises steeply at first, then flattens. Extracted/approximated from the published curve.
note: These values represent SUSTAINED weekly mileage, not single-week spikes. A runner must maintain a mileage level through progressive training cycles for the adaptation to count.

sub_three_zone.note: Target sustained weekly mileage range for sub-three marathon training. Beyond 80 may not provide meaningful additional benefit for the sub-three goal.
